source_caption_text:
**PART 2 OF 3 🧵 | THE MONEY & THE WITNESS WHO FLIPPED**

Nine days after MO3 was killed, $40,000 in cash came out of Yella Beezy's account.

Prosecutors say that money went through a middleman to the shooter, Kewon White. They say White sat outside MO3's apartment for 18 hours, waited for him to leave, and followed him onto I-35.

Then came the witness everyone was waiting on.

Jose Bodega, Beezy's childhood friend, had a federal deal. A gun charge was dropped, and he agreed to testify. His grand jury testimony ran more than 140 pages.

On the stand, he pleaded the Fifth.

Days later, prosecutors asked him about the beef he described to the grand jury. His answer: "I made it up."

The state's own witness took back his story in front of the jury.

And they still came back guilty.

Part 3: the verdict, life without parole, and the man coming for Beezy's money next.

🎥 Full breakdown on Ceddy Nash Uncut. Link in my story.

Did Bodega help Beezy or hurt him? 👇
